---
name: "💡 Enhancement / Idea"
about: Suggest a new feature, mechanic, or improvement
title: "[Enhancement] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Summary
One or two sentences describing the idea.

## Problem / Motivation
What gap, pain point, or missing mechanic does this address? (Skip if this is a pure addition with no existing problem, e.g. a new pill idea.)

## Proposed Solution
Describe what you'd like to see added or changed. Be as specific as you can — numbers, tiers, element interactions, etc. are welcome.

## Related Feature
Which system does this affect? (check all that apply)
- [ ] Alchemy cauldron / brewing
- [ ] Elixirs / pills (new pill, new effect)
- [ ] Cultivation / qi system
- [ ] Elements (Wind, Earth, Lightning, Ice, Water, Wood, Fire, None)
- [ ] Plants / herbs (new plant, spawn rules)
- [ ] UI / UX
- [ ] New Idea :
- [ ] Other:

## Example / Mockup (optional)
Sketch, table, or worked example of how this would behave. For a new pill idea, a quick recipe/tier/effect table is very helpful, e.g.:

| Tier | Recipe | Qi cost | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

## Alternatives Considered
Any other approaches you thought about, and why you'd prefer this one instead.

## Additional Context
Anything else — links to other games' mechanics that inspired this, balance concerns, etc.
